# RoBERTa-Tagalog Baseline Results

Model: `jcblaise/roberta-tagalog-base`
Protocol: stratified 80% training partition, six repetitions of five-fold stratified cross-validation, `random_state = 42` base seed.
Hyperparameters: learning rate 2e-5, batch size 16, epochs 3, max length 512, weight decay 0.01, warmup ratio 0.10, AdamW.
F1 values below use macro averaging across Fake and Real.

## Accuracy Across Datasets

| Classifier | Dataset | Standard Deviation | Accuracy |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Logistic Regression | Fake News Filipino 2020 | 0.00960 | 0.951 |
|  | Fake News Filipino 2024 | 0.00987 | 0.947 |
|  | Combined | 0.00939 | 0.924 |
| Multinomial Naive Bayes | Fake News Filipino 2020 | 0.0111 | 0.923 |
|  | Fake News Filipino 2024 | 0.0157 | 0.885 |
|  | Combined | 0.0140 | 0.860 |
| Random Forest | Fake News Filipino 2020 | 0.0145 | 0.919 |
|  | Fake News Filipino 2024 | 0.0118 | 0.926 |
|  | Combined | 0.0115 | 0.888 |
| Support Vector Classifier | Fake News Filipino 2020 | 0.00913 | 0.951 |
|  | Fake News Filipino 2024 | 0.00945 | 0.947 |
|  | Combined | 0.00907 | 0.922 |
| RoBERTa-Tagalog | Fake News Filipino 2020 | 0.00754 | 0.968 |
|  | Fake News Filipino 2024 | 0.00864 | 0.965 |
|  | Combined | 0.00605 | 0.952 |

## RoBERTa F1 And ROC-AUC

| Dataset | Accuracy | Macro F1 | ROC-AUC |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Fake News Filipino 2020 | 0.968 ± 0.008 | 0.968 ± 0.008 | 0.994 ± 0.003 |
| Fake News Filipino 2024 | 0.965 ± 0.009 | 0.965 ± 0.009 | 0.996 ± 0.001 |
| Combined | 0.952 ± 0.006 | 0.952 ± 0.006 | 0.990 ± 0.003 |

## ROC-AUC On Joint Corpus

| Classifier | ROC-AUC |
|---|---:|
| Multinomial Naive Bayes | 0.925 ± 0.010 |
| Logistic Regression | 0.976 ± 0.005 |
| Random Forest | 0.960 ± 0.006 |
| Support Vector Classifier | 0.973 ± 0.005 |
| RoBERTa-Tagalog | 0.990 ± 0.003 |

## Representative Confusion Matrix

Joint corpus, fold 10, selected as the fold closest to the joint-corpus mean accuracy. Labels: Fake = 0, Real = 1.

| Classifier | Actual Class | Predicted Fake | Predicted Real |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| RoBERTa-Tagalog | Actual Fake | 493 | 19 |
|  | Actual Real | 30 | 483 |

## Model Size And Inference

| Model | Parameters | Model Size On Disk |
|---|---:|---:|
| Logistic Regression | 1,451,808 | 66.04 MB |
| RoBERTa-Tagalog | 109,083,650 | 418.17 MB |

Mean inference time per article on 30 joint-corpus articles: 19.410 ms (SD=0.889 ms, median=19.182 ms).
